title: Undergraduate research & teaching support
institution: Universidade Federal Fluminense · Praia Vermelha Campus
description: Scientific initiation and teaching support, building a foundation in climate science and environmental research.
impact: Connected engineering education with scientific investigation through rainfall–runoff modeling and exploratory data analysis.

title: Environmental internship
description: Supported data-driven decisions, quality control of rainfall and streamflow data, and geospatial analysis within water security and hydrological information services.
impact: Improved the practical use and automation of hydrological and geospatial information for environmental operations.

title: UFF representative
institution: Fórum das Juventudes em Mudanças Climáticas de Niterói
description: Volunteer role as UFF’s titular representative in Niterói’s youth climate forum.
impact: Participated in local climate dialogue and connected university perspectives with youth climate action.

title: Urban resilience & environmental policy
institution: Secretaria de Estado do Ambiente e Sustentabilidade
description: Contributed to Programa Ambiente Resiliente, supporting municipalities in Rio de Janeiro with geoprocessing and data-driven public policy. The program was established by SEAS Ordinance 195 of July 23, 2024.
impact: Provided technical support for more informed municipal resilience planning and contributed to the implementation of the Resilient Environment Program.

title: Conversational AI for environmental operations
description: Developed a conversational application connecting domain knowledge and internal environmental forecast and observation APIs through RAG and MCP.
impact: Reported outcomes: reduced hallucinations, improved domain diagnostics and immediate adoption by meteorologists, hydrologists and stakeholders.

title: Climate extremes & socio-environmental vulnerability
institution: LAMMOC · Fluminense Federal University, Praia Vermelha Campus
description: Research at the Laboratory for Monitoring and Modeling of Climate Systems, characterizing climate extremes with ERA5 and projecting them through CMIP6 models, with a focus on droughts, heavy precipitation, heatwaves and socio-environmental vulnerability.
impact: Contributing to the characterization of climate hazards and the assessment of present and future climate risk in Brazil.
